name: Silvanus

attributes.attribute: Roman name for Celtic woodland gods
habit of recasting local gods as Roman ones
Celtic god linked with Silvanus by Koch

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Silvanus is a Roman god. The Romans gave this name to native Celtic woodland gods. Most of the native names have vanished. They fell to the interpretatio romana, the habit of recasting local gods as Roman ones. The Celtic wood god faded under the Roman title. Koch links him with Sucellus, another Celtic god. The bond shows that a native god kept power under a Roman name. No single native name survives to pair with him. The link is not proven at every site. It remains one clear case of the habit at work across the Celtic lands.
